title: Mandatory etymological-semantic coverage registry
principle: No central concept proceeds without ETY-MIN; no etymological result substitutes for local, conceptual, historical or phenomenological evidence.
source_note: Entries are project-level starting dispositions derived from the supplied protocol. Historical derivations remain provisional until independently lexicographically sourced.

REALITAS.morphology: Abstract formation associated with realis/res; exact historical stages require lexicographic attestation.
REALITAS.derivation: Medieval Latin philosophical usage is a project hypothesis, not established by this registry alone.
REALITAS.sense_range: thinghood; reality; whatness/reality in scholastic and later retrospective vocabularies
REALITAS.translation_residual: A Russian or German cognate can conceal shifts between thinghood, existence and actuality.
REALITAS.function: May name a mode, predicate or assumed independent object depending on the argument.
REALITAS.counter_line: Track the same philosophical function where the cognate disappears, and the cognate where its function changes.
REALITAS.lost_distinction: Reality vocabulary need not coincide with existence or actuality vocabulary.
REALITAS.semantic_drift: The term can migrate from scholastic determination toward a general modern reality predicate.
REALITAS.new_question: Which function of the real is active in this dated passage?

REALITAET.morphology: Learned abstract noun; surface form alone does not establish its philosophical history.
REALITAET.derivation: Related to Latin realitas through learned vocabulary; borrowing history requires an external dictionary source.
REALITAET.sense_range: reality; objective reality; real content; reality as opposed to ideality or appearance
REALITAET.translations: реальность; действительность in some traditions; reality
REALITAET.translation_residual: Translating both Realität and Wirklichkeit as one Russian term erases a potentially operative contrast.
REALITAET.function: Can secure objectivity, independence, content or a contrast class.
REALITAET.counter_line: Test passages in which Realität and Wirklichkeit overlap or exchange roles.
REALITAET.lost_distinction: Object-reality and actuality/effectiveness may be separate parameters.
REALITAET.semantic_drift: A stable form can carry different burdens across scholastic, neo-Kantian and phenomenological contexts.
REALITAET.new_question: Does Realität here name existence, content, independence or objective validity?

WIRKLICHKEIT.morphology: wirklich + -keit; any further appeal to wirken is a hypothesis requiring local and historical checks.
WIRKLICHKEIT.derivation: The visible word family wirklich/wirken supplies a comparison, not proof of current sense.
WIRKLICHKEIT.translation_residual: Russian действительность can foreground actuality while реальность can collapse the contrast with Realität.
WIRKLICHKEIT.function: May oppose possibility, appearance or ideality and may carry an actuality burden.
WIRKLICHKEIT.counter_line: Seek uses where Wirklichkeit lacks any efficacy implication and uses of actuality under other words.
WIRKLICHKEIT.lost_distinction: Actuality and reality are not automatically coextensive.
WIRKLICHKEIT.semantic_drift: The word family can preserve form while philosophical function moves among efficacy, actuality and objectivity.
WIRKLICHKEIT.new_question: Which contrast makes Wirklichkeit determinate here?

SEIN.morphology: Nominalized infinitive; nominal form must not turn the referent into a thing.
SEIN.derivation: Germanic verbal history and philosophical nominalization require independent historical sources.
SEIN.sense_range: being; to be; beingness; intelligibility; horizon or event in author-specific uses
SEIN.translation_residual: Nominal Russian бытие may hide verbal, predicative and operator differences.
SEIN.function: Predicate, horizon, difference, intelligibility condition or later operator; role must be locally typed.
SEIN.counter_line: Follow being-functions under other vocabularies and repeated Sein with discontinuous roles.
SEIN.lost_distinction: The word and the meta-ontological role are not identical.
SEIN.semantic_drift: The load can migrate from predication to horizon, difference and event without one continuous definition.
SEIN.new_question: What work does Sein perform in this argument rather than in the corpus as a whole?

EXISTENZ.morphology: Learned noun; surface similarity to Latin exsistentia does not fix local function.
EXISTENZ.derivation: Borrowing and philosophical specialization require external attestation.
EXISTENZ.sense_range: existence; actuality; a specific way of being; Dasein's existential mode
EXISTENZ.translation_residual: Экзистенция can preserve technicality while obscuring ordinary existence and vice versa.
EXISTENZ.function: Can answer whether something is, or name a distinctive mode of Dasein.
EXISTENZ.counter_line: Compare nontechnical existence uses with Heideggerian specialization.
EXISTENZ.lost_distinction: Existence predicate and existential mode must not be conflated.
EXISTENZ.semantic_drift: A general existence term can acquire a region-specific existential function.
EXISTENZ.new_question: Is Existenz here a thin existential claim or a mode-specific articulation?

AKT.function: Names an occurrence or intentional performance, not automatically its content or object.

INHALT.function: Can name immanent material, meaning or propositional content; local typing is mandatory.

GEGENSTAND.morphology: gegen + Stand is synchronically visible but cannot by itself prove an object theory.
GEGENSTAND.sense_range: object; subject matter; that which stands over against
GEGENSTAND.translation_residual: Предмет and объект distribute intentional and ontic emphases differently.
GEGENSTAND.function: Names an intentional pole, object or thematic matter depending on context.

LICHTUNG.morphology: Related in ordinary German to clearing/open space; authorial wordplay must be separated from historical derivation.
LICHTUNG.sense_range: clearing; openness; clearing as a condition of appearing
LICHTUNG.function: Late operator of openness that can inherit some burdens of Sein without simple synonymy.

EREIGNIS.morphology: Ordinary and authorial segmentations must be kept distinct.
EREIGNIS.function: Late operator whose authorial etymologization cannot replace dated argument reconstruction.

DESTRUKTION.translation_residual: Разрушение can erase retrieval and positive appropriation.
DESTRUKTION.function: Method of loosening inherited necessity and retrieving concealed possibilities.

MACHENSCHAFT.morphology: Visible relation to machen is not a sufficient history-of-being argument.
MACHENSCHAFT.sense_range: machination; makeability; power-laden production in authorial use
MACHENSCHAFT.function: Late-1930s diagnosis of makeability/objectifiability, not a synonym of Gestell.

TECHNIK.translation_residual: Техника can name artifacts, skill or a system; technology often narrows/modernizes the field.
TECHNIK.function: Object, practice, instrument or mode-of-revealing must be separated.

GESTELL.morphology: Authorial hyphenation and ordinary noun history are distinct evidential objects.
GESTELL.sense_range: frame/rack; enframing as authorial ordering operator
GESTELL.translation_residual: Постав preserves technical coinage but can hide ordinary semantic friction.

BESTAND.sense_range: stock; inventory; persistence; standing-reserve in authorial use
BESTAND.translation_residual: One translation cannot preserve inventory, endurance and resourceization at once.
BESTAND.function: Contextual resource-status rather than simple object identity.

IDENTITAET.translation_residual: Russian terms can redistribute logical and personal/social senses.
IDENTITAET.function: Numerical sameness, persistence or criterion must be separated.

SELBIGKEIT.function: May articulate belonging-together without replacing numerical identity.

INDIVIDUATION.function: Names a principle, operation or problem of ontological counting.

GRENZE.translation_residual: Граница and предел distribute spatial and modal senses differently.
GRENZE.function: May separate, enable, filter or maintain a difference; surface is only one type.

RELATION.sense_range: formal relation; ratio; dependence; reference; coupling
RELATION.translation_residual: One Russian relation word can collapse edge type, direction and mechanism.
RELATION.function: Requires typed relata, direction, mechanism and ontological burden.

GRUND.sense_range: ground; reason; cause; basis; soil; bottom
GRUND.translation_residual: No single Russian equivalent preserves physical, rational and ontological roles.
GRUND.function: Must be typed as cause, reason, motive, condition or ontological ground.

KONSTITUTION.function: May concern sense, identity, validity, status or existence; not automatically production.

ERMOEGLICHUNG.morphology: Derived from ermöglichen/Möglichkeit; morphology does not establish necessity or sufficiency.
ERMOEGLICHUNG.sense_range: enabling; making possible; condition of possibility
ERMOEGLICHUNG.function: Must specify what is enabled and whether the relation is necessary, sufficient, epistemic or ontological.
